variants.title: Radiation pattern of a full-wave dipole antenna
variants.unknown: the half-power beamwidth of a full-wave dipole
variants.note: A dipole one wavelength long has a narrower beam, about 48 degrees, and twice the peak field of a half-wave one at the same current.

source.title: C. A. Balanis, Antenna Theory: half-power beamwidth of a full-wave dipole about 47.8 degrees (from the pattern)

variants.title: Radiation pattern of a short dipole antenna (a tenth of a wavelength)
variants.sample: Dipole a tenth of a wavelength long (ell = 0.1)
variants.unknown: the half-power beamwidth of a short dipole
variants.note: A short dipole's pattern tends to sin theta with a beamwidth of 90 degrees, but its field is much weaker at the same current.

source.title: C. A. Balanis, Antenna Theory: the short dipole, E proportional to sin theta
